input.summary: Reduce non-renewal notice to 30 days and add Vendor renewal reminder
input.comment: [Playbook] We reduced the non-renewal notice window from 180 days to 30 days and added a Vendor reminder 60 days before each renewal, keeping the renewal term at twelve months; our playbook requires auto-renewals to be easy to exit. If helpful, we can accept up to 60 days' notice as a fallback.

ops.oldText: Each Order Form renews for twelve months unless either Party gives one hundred eighty days' advance written notice.
ops.newText: Each Order Form renews for successive twelve-month terms unless either Party gives thirty days' advance written notice before the end of the then-current term. Vendor shall notify Customer of the upcoming renewal, the renewal term, and the renewal Fees at least sixty days before the renewal date.
